args.summary:
Question: Average bill length by island for Adelie penguins.

Data problems found and fixes applied:
- species column had label variants (case/space differences and misspellings: "adelie", "Adeile", "Gentoo ", "Chinstrap ", "Chinstarp", "Gentto"). Normalized all 7 cells into the allowed labels (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) so all Adelie penguins are counted together. This was the only fix needed.
- bill_length_mm: clean — all values numeric, in range [30, 60], no missing values, no negatives.
- island: clean (Biscoe, Dream, Torgersen).

Result — average bill_length_mm by island for Adelie penguins (13 rows used):
- Biscoe: 40.93 mm
- Dream: 38.75 mm
- Torgersen: 40.70 mm

Caveat: The species normalization merged misspellings into allowed labels (per rules), which is appropriate here since these are clearly the same species. No rows were excluded.
